race.description: Mildura & District Real Estate Mdn Plate
race.comment: KINKY MISTRESS (4) is on debut for the Patrick Payne stable and has shown enough at her public outings to suggest she has ability. Martin has been on board for her last three outings and sticks with her on debut today, including a heat behind Skybird in late September. Can make a bright start. MOON GOD (10) is another who has shown promising signs at the jump outs, showing positive signs in her latest heat where Declan Bates rode her. Drawn a little awkwardly, but if she gets some luck from the draw, then she'll be right in the mix. ILOVEDIAMONDS (3) disappointed last time out at Bairnsdale but was out to 1200m there and her prior form was solid. Drawn inside again now back to 1000m and a better run is on the cards. GOLD BIJOUX (9) didn't have the best of luck on debut at Ballarat and although she's drawn wide this time, it may suit her better so she can get into clear air. Can show what she's capable of today.
